name: badge
purpose: Short static label such as 'Active', 'Beta', or '3 new' that classifies the content next to it. The label text carries the meaning; tone colors, the optional dot, and the optional icon are decorative. Never interactive.
whenToUse: Status or category of an item in a list, table cell, card, or heading: Active, Draft, Overdue, Beta.
A count that belongs to a label, such as '3 new' beside a section title.
whenNotToUse: Tags the user can remove or select: use Tag Group.
Status that changes while the user works and must be announced: use Inline Message with live set.
Messages that need explanation or actions: use Alert.
responsive: Inline-flex pill limited to its container width; a long label is truncated with an ellipsis.
rtl: Logical properties: the dot or icon sits at the inline start in both directions.
theme: Subtle: color-{tone}-subtle fill with color-text label; outline: color-surface fill with a color-{tone}-fg boundary; neutral uses color-surface-sunken and color-border-strong. Label pairs are in the contrast gate. Component tokens: badge-radius, badge-padding-x, badge-font-weight. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText boundary and dot.
security: The label is rendered with textContent; never parsed as HTML. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.
limitations: Text only: no links or rich content.
Long labels are truncated; keep labels to one or two words.
unsupported: Interactive badges (click, remove, select): use Tag Group or Button.
Rendering HTML or Nodes as the label.
antiPatterns: Conveying meaning by tone color alone (the label must make sense without it).
Using a badge as a button or link.
